verdict.rationale: Runway documents its own concurrency features: plans allow up to 20 parallel video and image generations, and the API platform can run the same prompt across multiple models at once. This is fan-out generation rather than a true bulk-operations feature over many existing items. The async task API alone is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint or UI for acting on many items at once (bulk edit, export, delete, or batch job submission), and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
